## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(car)
library(rstatix)
library(GGally)
```

```{r}
xlsx_path <- if (file.exists("Project1data.xlsx")) "Project1data.xlsx" else "/Users/bjorn_ahl/Downloads/GitHub/MASM22/Project_1/Project1data.xlsx"
df <- as.data.frame(read_excel(xlsx_path))
```

## 1(a)

```{r}
cutoff <- quantile(df$PM10, probs = 2/3)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    pm10_high = as.numeric(PM10 >= cutoff),
    pm10_cat  = factor(pm10_high, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low", "High"))
  )

table(df$pm10_cat)
```
